# Tentacle
English | 中文
Tentacle is a curated plugin bundle for DeepSeek Harness (DSH).
The name is the mission. DSH is a single-user local agent; Tentacle gives it arms into the world — i
dentity and isolation for many users, IM channels for eight platforms, an expert library, expert tea
ms, SSO, and whatever else lets it reach people, services and data. Installing one bundle turns the
local agent into a multi-user, multi-channel, multi-expert workspace, and the bundle keeps growing.
Scope is open by design: **anything that helps DSH connect is a candidate package.** A new data sour
ce, tool or platform integration that makes DSH a first-class citizen somewhere is in scope; re-impl
ementing what DSH already does is not.
**Multi-tenant by design.** Identity, authorization, and per-user isolation are the foundation every
thing else grows from — not an afterthought.
## What you get
Channels — Feishu, Telegram, DingTalk, WeCom, QQ, WeChat, Yuanbao, Discord; platform identities beco
Telegram, DingTalk, WeCom, QQ, WeChat, Yuanbao, Discord; platform identities become tenant sessions.
Data Studio — datasets, branchable threads, 39 chart templates, AI refinement and reports.
- **Identity & tenancy** — login gate, user directory, invites, policies, ReBAC memberships, admin c

onsole.
- **Experts & teams** — expert library, shared Agent presets, workspace skills, channel rout

ing, first-class expert teams.
- **Channels** — one gateway for eight IM platforms, with adapters di

sabled until configured.
- **Data Studio** — imports and connectors, branching analysis threads, nat

ive + Flint charts, reports.
- **SSO & isolation** — OIDC browser login, per-user workspaces, authen
ticated HTTP/RPC/WS proxy.

h against a real DSH process. APIs and package layout may still change.
